title: CareSphere Elder
description: CareSphere Elder is a dedicated management solution for elder homes and senior care centres, designed to bring admissions, residents, care operations, bookings, reporting, and daily workflows into one centralized platform.

Developed by SurfUX, the platform helps care organizations reduce manual administration and manage essential information through a structured digital workspace with dashboards, records, booking workflows, notifications, and operational reporting.
CareSphere Elder forms the first specialized solution within the CareSphere ecosystem, providing a scalable foundation for modern elder care management.

title: CareSphere Child
description: CareSphere Child is a specialized management solution designed for children's homes and child care organizations, bringing essential records, admissions, care activities, resources, and reporting into one connected platform.

The solution extends the CareSphere ecosystem with workflows tailored to organizations responsible for children, helping teams organize information, monitor daily operations, and maintain a clearer view of care and support activities.
CareSphere Child is designed as a scalable digital foundation that can evolve with the operational needs of children's homes and related care organizations.

title: CareSphere Residential
description: CareSphere Residential is a flexible management solution for residential care organizations that need to coordinate residents, rooms, admissions, staff, resources, and daily operational activities.

The platform brings core residential workflows into a centralized system, helping organizations maintain structured records, improve visibility across operations, and support more consistent day-to-day management.
As part of the CareSphere ecosystem, CareSphere Residential is designed to support different residential care models while maintaining a common technology foundation.

title: CareSphere Charity
description: CareSphere Charity is a dedicated management solution for charities and social impact organizations, designed to organize beneficiaries, donations, programmes, supporters, and operational activities in one connected platform.

The solution helps organizations maintain structured records and improve visibility across programmes and resources while creating a stronger digital foundation for transparent and organized charity operations.
CareSphere Charity completes the initial four-solution CareSphere ecosystem, extending the platform beyond residential care into broader community support and social impact management.

title: CandleAid Lanka – Management System
alt: CandleAid Lanka Management System developed by SurfUX
description: CandleAid Lanka is a non-profit organization that supports people and communities through humanitarian and social support initiatives. SurfUX developed a centralized software solution to help organize its operational information and reduce dependence on traditional manual records and spreadsheets.

The system provides a structured digital environment for managing organizational data and day-to-day workflows, helping staff access information more efficiently while improving consistency across records and operations.
Designed as a practical management solution for a real-world non-profit organization, the platform supports a more organized approach to administration, reporting, and information management.

title: ENISHI Global
description:
ENISHI Global is an international education platform helping
            Sri Lankan students build their pathway towards Japan through
            Japanese language education, student guidance, and international
            study opportunities.

SurfUX designed and developed a modern, culturally inspired website
            that connects the aspirations of Sri Lankan students with
            educational opportunities in Japan. The visual direction combines
            a sophisticated Japanese-inspired aesthetic with clear,
            student-focused communication.

The website guides students through the complete journey — from
            learning Japanese and exploring study opportunities to receiving
            individual consultation and preparing for their next chapter in
            Japan. The responsive experience ensures that students can easily
            explore programmes and begin their journey across any device.

title: Ameliya Holidays
alt: Ameliya Holidays Sri Lanka Travel Website
description:
Ameliya Holidays is a Sri Lanka travel company creating
            personalized holiday experiences for couples, families, friends,
            and independent travelers.

SurfUX designed and developed a modern travel website that
            showcases the beauty and diversity of Sri Lanka through immersive
            destination imagery, engaging storytelling, and a simple,
            traveler-focused experience.

The website brings together popular destinations, customized
            itineraries, and flexible travel experiences while making it easy
            for visitors to connect directly with the travel team. A dedicated
            WhatsApp booking experience provides a fast and familiar way for
            travelers to start planning their journey.

title: Lily Wellness Spa
description:
Lily Wellness Spa is a serene wellness destination in Galle,
            Sri Lanka, offering relaxing spa treatments, natural wellness
            experiences, and traditional Ayurvedic-inspired therapies.

SurfUX designed and developed a calming, premium website that
            reflects the spa's philosophy of relaxation, restoration, and
            natural wellness. The visual experience combines elegant
            typography, warm natural tones, immersive imagery, and a refined
            user interface to create a sense of tranquility from the moment
            visitors arrive.

The website makes it simple for guests to discover treatments,
            understand the spa experience, and book their preferred treatment.
            The responsive design ensures the same peaceful and intuitive
            experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

title: Sky Foundation
description:
Sky Foundation is a community-focused non-profit organisation
            committed to creating opportunities and building a brighter future
            for children, families, and communities.

SurfUX designed and developed a modern, human-centered website that
            communicates the foundation's mission, impact, and community
            initiatives through powerful storytelling and meaningful visual
            content.

The platform was designed to make it easy for visitors to understand
            the organisation's work, explore its initiatives, get involved, and
            support its mission. A warm, accessible visual language helps build
            trust while keeping the focus on the people and communities being
            supported.

title: Cenova Ceylon Export
description:
Cenova Ceylon Export is a Sri Lankan export company focused on
            delivering authentic Ceylon cinnamon and premium agricultural
            products to customers and businesses around the world.

SurfUX designed and developed a modern corporate website that
            communicates the company's Sri Lankan origin, product quality, and
            international export capabilities. The visual direction combines
            natural tones, premium product photography, and a clean interface
            to create a strong and trustworthy export brand.

The website is designed to connect international wholesalers,
            distributors, food businesses, and private-label brands with
            authentic Sri Lankan products while providing a clear and
            streamlined path for product discovery and quotation requests.

title: Aloka Elder's Home – Admin Dashboard
description:
The Aloka Elder's Home Admin Dashboard is a comprehensive management platform
                  built to simplify daily operations, resident admissions, care coordination,
                  and reporting through a centralized digital system.

SurfUX designed and developed an intuitive dashboard that enables staff to
                  manage bookings, resident records, caregiver assignments, meal preferences,
                  notifications, and operational reports from a single interface. The system
                  improves administrative efficiency while reducing manual paperwork and
                  streamlining day-to-day workflows.

With responsive access across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, the
                  platform provides administrators with real-time insights into occupancy,
                  admissions, and resident management, ensuring a faster and more organized
                  care management process.

title: Arches Fort
description:
Arches Fort is a boutique heritage hotel located within the historic
                  walls of Galle Fort, offering guests a unique blend of colonial
                  elegance, modern comfort, and authentic Sri Lankan hospitality.

SurfUX designed and developed a premium hospitality website that
                  captures the timeless character of the property while delivering a
                  seamless digital experience. The design emphasizes immersive
                  photography, elegant typography, and intuitive navigation to inspire
                  travelers from around the world.

The website enables visitors to explore accommodation, hotel
                  facilities, nearby attractions, and local experiences while
                  strengthening the hotel's online presence and reinforcing its luxury
                  brand identity across all devices.

title: Aloka Elder's Home
description:
Aloka Elder's Home is a compassionate residential care facility dedicated
                  to providing a safe, comfortable, and dignified living environment for
                  senior citizens through professional care and personalized support.

SurfUX designed and developed a modern, accessible website that enables
                  families to explore accommodation, care services, facilities, and the
                  home's compassionate approach with confidence. The design focuses on
                  warmth, trust, and simplicity while ensuring an intuitive user experience
                  across all devices.

The platform also includes an online inquiry and booking system, making
                  it easier for families to schedule visits, request admissions, and connect
                  with the care team. The result is a professional digital presence that
                  reflects Aloka Elder's Home's commitment to quality elder care.

title: Maniq Ceylon – Admin Dashboard
description:
The Maniq Ceylon Admin Dashboard is a centralized platform designed
                  to manage gemstone inventory, catalogue updates, and product
                  availability in real time.

SurfUX developed this dashboard to give full control over the
                  e-catalogue system, allowing administrators to easily add, update,
                  and manage gemstones across multiple categories such as sapphires,
                  spinels, garnets, and more.

The system is built with a clean and intuitive interface, ensuring
                  efficient workflow management while maintaining accuracy, speed, and
                  consistency across the entire digital catalogue.

title: Go China Holidays
description:
Go China Holidays is a modern travel platform dedicated to helping
                  travelers discover China's rich cultural heritage, iconic landmarks,
                  and unforgettable travel experiences through carefully curated tour
                  packages.

SurfUX designed and developed a visually engaging, responsive website
                  that showcases destinations, travel itineraries, and guided tour
                  experiences with a clean and intuitive user interface. The platform
                  was created to inspire confidence while making trip planning simple
                  and accessible for international travelers.

The website emphasizes immersive destination imagery, streamlined
                  navigation, and clear calls-to-action, providing a seamless browsing
                  experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices while
                  strengthening the brand's global digital presence.

title: CourierFlex UI/UX Design
alt: CourierFlex courier service landing page UI UX design created by SurfUX
description:
This UI/UX design project was created for CourierFlex, a modern
                  courier and delivery service platform focused on fast, reliable,
                  and user-friendly parcel delivery experiences.

The interface was carefully designed to provide a clean visual
                  hierarchy, engaging layout composition, and a smooth user journey.
                  The landing page combines modern typography, strategic spacing,
                  and vibrant branding elements to improve user engagement and
                  conversion rates while maintaining full responsiveness across all
                  devices.

title: Go Philippines Holidays
description:
Go Philippines Holidays is a travel platform created to inspire
                  travelers to discover the breathtaking islands, pristine beaches,
                  vibrant culture, and unforgettable experiences that the Philippines
                  has to offer.

SurfUX designed and developed a modern, visually engaging website that
                  showcases curated tour packages, popular destinations, and personalized
                  travel experiences. The user interface was crafted to simplify trip
                  planning while encouraging visitors to confidently explore and book
                  their next adventure.

Built with a responsive, performance-focused design, the platform
                  delivers a seamless browsing experience across desktop, tablet, and
                  mobile devices while strengthening the brand's digital presence and
                  increasing customer engagement.

title: Maniq Ceylon – E-Catalogue Platform
description:
Maniq Ceylon’s e-catalogue is a premium digital platform designed to
                  showcase rare, natural gemstones in a refined and visually immersive
                  environment.

SurfUX developed this catalogue experience to simplify how global
                  buyers explore and discover gemstones. The interface allows users to
                  browse by gemstone type such as Blue Sapphire, Padparadscha, Spinel,
                  and Zircon while maintaining a clean, luxury focused presentation.

Each gemstone is presented with clarity and elegance, ensuring that
                  attention remains on color, cut, and brilliance key factors in
                  high value gemstone selection.

title: Architecture Portfolio UI/UX Design
alt: Modern architecture portfolio UI UX design created by SurfUX
description:
This UI/UX design project was developed for a modern architecture
                  portfolio website focused on showcasing personal branding,
                  creative direction, and professional architectural services.

The design approach combines a minimal dark aesthetic with bold
                  typography, cinematic visual presentation, and strategic layout
                  composition to create a premium digital experience. Special
                  attention was given to portfolio visibility, user engagement,
                  responsive performance, and elegant interaction flow to ensure the
                  website reflects both creativity and professionalism.

title: Great Ocean Tours
description:
Great Ocean Tours is an international travel company providing
                  customized travel experiences and ground handling services across
                  Hong Kong, the Philippines, India, and other destinations.

SurfUX designed and developed a modern, conversion-focused website
                  that showcases the company's travel expertise, destination services,
                  and international tour packages. The design combines immersive
                  visuals with intuitive navigation to help travelers confidently
                  explore destinations and submit tour inquiries.

Built with a responsive, performance-driven architecture, the
                  platform delivers a consistent experience across desktop, tablet,
                  and mobile devices while strengthening the company's global digital
                  presence and supporting future business growth.

title: Liyan Maniq
description:
Liyan Maniq is a premium gemstone brand specializing in ethically
                  sourced, natural gemstones from Sri Lanka and Madagascar.

SurfUX partnered with Liyan Maniq to create a refined digital presence
                  that reflects trust, luxury, and authenticity. The goal was to present
                  gemstones not just as products, but as rare investments and timeless
                  pieces of natural beauty.

The platform was designed to highlight transparency from mine to
                  market while delivering a seamless browsing experience for global
                  buyers seeking certified, high-quality gemstones.

title: AurumFlux UI/UX Design
alt: AurumFlux modern technology website UI UX homepage design by SurfUX
description:
This UI/UX design project was created for AurumFlux, a modern
                  digital technology company focused on AI solutions, IoT systems,
                  data analytics, and digital transformation services.

The website interface was designed with a futuristic dark-themed
                  visual style combined with premium typography, modern layouts, and
                  strategic user experience principles. The design emphasizes
                  innovation, scalability, and professionalism while creating a
                  smooth and engaging browsing experience across desktop and mobile
                  devices.

Special attention was given to service presentation, visual
                  hierarchy, interaction flow, and conversion-focused call-to-action
                  sections to strengthen the brand’s digital identity and improve
                  user engagement.

title: CIATS
description:
CIATS is a Sri Lankan institute specializing in professional
                  surveying services and industry focused technical education.

This project focused on creating a strong, professional digital
                  presence that reflects the institute’s expertise, credibility,
                  and contribution to national development. The website highlights
                  both service offerings and training programs, positioning CIATS
                  as a trusted partner for industries and an educational pathway
                  for future professionals.

The platform was designed to balance technical authority with
                  accessibility, ensuring clear communication of services,
                  practical learning opportunities, and modern surveying solutions.

title: Park N Ride UI/UX Design
alt: Park N Ride airport parking booking platform UI UX design created by SurfUX
description:
This UI/UX design project was developed for Park N Ride, an
                  airport parking and shuttle booking platform focused on providing
                  travelers with a simple, reliable, and stress-free parking
                  experience.

The interface was designed with a modern and user-friendly layout
                  that allows users to quickly search, compare, and reserve airport
                  parking services with ease. The design combines strong visual
                  hierarchy, responsive layouts, and clean booking workflows to
                  improve usability and increase customer engagement.

Special attention was given to the booking section, call-to-action
                  areas, and accessibility across all devices to create a seamless
                  experience for users planning airport transportation and parking
                  services online.

title: SpamShield
description:
SpamShield is an AI-powered spam protection platform designed to
                  block bots and unwanted submissions without disrupting real users.

SurfUX partnered with SpamShield to support the product’s digital
                  presence through strategic positioning, user focused design, and
                  clear product storytelling. The goal was to communicate trust,
                  simplicity, and technical credibility to both developers and
                  businesses.

The solution emphasizes seamless integration, no-captcha protection,
                  and long-term reliability helping businesses secure their forms while
                  maintaining a smooth user experience.

title: Velvora Travels
description:
Velvora Travels is a luxury travel company connecting
                  European travellers with curated journeys across Sri Lanka,
                  with expanding destinations across the Maldives and Asia.

This project focused on building a visually immersive,
                  modern travel platform that showcases signature tour
                  experiences including adventure, cultural heritage,
                  wildlife, wellness retreats, and romantic escapes. The
                  website was designed to highlight trust, premium service,
                  and seamless user experience while making tour selection
                  simple and engaging.

title: NutriDry Ceylon
description:
This project involved designing and developing a clean,
                  modern website for NutriDry Ceylon, a Sri Lankan brand
                  specializing in premium dehydrated fruits and vegetables
                  made from carefully selected local produce.

The website communicates the brand’s commitment to natural
                  goodness, quality, and nutrition through a fresh visual
                  identity and clear content structure. Emphasis was placed on
                  showcasing product benefits, origin, and healthy lifestyle
                  use cases while ensuring a smooth, engaging browsing
                  experience across all devices.

title: Ceyluxe
description:
This website was developed for Ceyluxe, a Sri Lankan company
                  specializing in premium cinnamon-based products.

The project focused on creating a visually appealing and
                  modern online presence that reflects the quality and
                  authenticity of the brand. The platform highlights product
                  details, brand story, and customer value while offering a
                  smooth browsing and purchase experience.

title: Pest Control Service
description:
This project focused on designing and developing a modern,
                  responsive website for Tanga Pest Control to strengthen
                  their digital presence and clearly communicate their
                  services.

The website presents pest, termite, and rodent control
                  solutions in a clean and professional layout, ensuring easy
                  navigation and accessibility across all devices. Emphasis
                  was placed on trust, clarity, and user experience to help
                  convert visitors into potential customers.

title: Suren Dissanayaka
description:
This project involved designing and developing a clean,
                  modern portfolio website for Suren Dissanayaka, a Chartered
                  Architect in Sri Lanka.

The website showcases selected architectural works with a
                  strong emphasis on visual presentation, clarity, and
                  professional identity. A minimalist layout, thoughtful
                  typography, and smooth user experience were implemented to
                  reflect the architect’s design philosophy while ensuring
                  accessibility and responsiveness across all devices.

title: Hikka Tours
description:
This project involved designing and developing a modern,
                  user-friendly website for Hikka Tours, a Sri Lankan tourism
                  company offering curated travel experiences.

The website showcases tour packages, destinations, and
                  services with a visually engaging layout that inspires
                  travel while maintaining clear navigation and accessibility.
                  A strong focus was placed on performance, responsiveness,
                  and lead generation to help convert visitors into inquiries
                  and bookings across all devices.

title: DnD Architecture
description:
DnD Architecture is a Sri Lankan architectural firm known
                  for modern and functional design solutions.

This website was created to showcase their services,
                  portfolio, and expertise in residential and commercial
                  architecture. The design focuses on a clean, professional
                  look with responsive layouts and easy navigation, ensuring
                  clients can quickly explore projects and request
                  consultations.

title: Gihan Supun
description:
This portfolio website was designed for Gihan Supun, a
                  senior UI/UX engineer from Sri Lanka with extensive
                  international experience across Australia, the UK, UAE,
                  Canada, and Europe.

The platform showcases his professional journey, design
                  approach, and diverse project portfolio in a clean, modern,
                  and user-focused layout. The website includes dedicated
                  sections for case studies, skills, testimonials, and career
                  highlights, offering a clear representation of his expertise
                  while making it easy for potential clients and employers to
                  connect.
